portsSource.note: p.1 (unterminated cable with three shielded audio pairs and three logic conductors, LED IN / LOGIC OUT, dimensions, weight); wire colours from MX396 user guide p.4-5 (shure/MX396-user-guide.pdf)

_avail.notes: Variant "Cardioid" → "Cardioid, Dual" (from the part number; the intake form gave one Variant to several part numbers)

ports.label: Mic 1 Out
ports.notes: Element A, mic level, active balanced; attached 6.1 m (20 ft) unterminated cable: white = +, green = -, shield = common ground; each element needs its own phantom-powered mic input (48-52 V DC)

ports.label: Mic 2 Out
ports.notes: Element B, mic level, active balanced; same cable: orange = +, blue = -; own phantom-powered mic input

ports.label: Switch Out
ports.notes: Mute button logic output (output only), red wire of the same cable; TTL, active low, sinks up to 20 mA; momentary or toggle (DIP 1); logic ground = silver (bare) wire

ports.label: LED In
ports.notes: LED control input (input only), black wire of the same cable; active low (<=1.0 V), TTL; grounded = green, open = red; connect to an automixer gate output (DIP 3 up)
